scope: Read-only raster/crops of real root-operated SVG export. These are not browser screenshots, physical print previews, human publication reviews, or new exports made by this agent.

visibleObservations.location: actual-export-top.png, top mask rows and long decoder right-side corridors
visibleObservations.observation: Multiple dashed mask lines run close together around the upper perimeter and turn down at the right side of the decoder. At overview fit they cannot be individually followed reliably.
visibleObservations.recommendation: Provide visible edge binding highlight and trunk/junction distinction while preserving canonical identities.

visibleObservations.location: actual-export-decoder.png, self attention output→Add and cross attention output→Add
visibleObservations.observation: Main data paths have short horizontal elbows between vertically adjacent nodes. Endpoints are attached, and labels in this crop are not pierced, but the route is visually more bent than the apparent vertical main flow.
visibleObservations.recommendation: Offer a visual explicit alignment or guided corridor action; do not change manually placed nodes without the user action.

visibleObservations.location: actual-export-top.png, encoder/decoder frame headers and attention boxes
visibleObservations.observation: Module borders, padding and internal category colors remain distinguishable. No clipping or text-through-route is visible in the reviewed crop; this does not exclude problems elsewhere.
visibleObservations.recommendation: Keep this hierarchy grammar; validate larger expansions and moved states separately.

visibleObservations.location: actual-export-top.png, source/target embedding and upper branch fan-out
visibleObservations.observation: Several distinct-colored orthogonal lanes cross or meet around the upper branch region; the preview does not supply a visual gap/jump that helps distinguish a crossing from a junction.
visibleObservations.recommendation: Use selection highlighting plus an explicit crossing/gap grammar, backed by tensor semantics, rather than assuming every touching line is a connection.
